dispositions.disposition: A zero-length placement list is not established for an exhibit produced by the inspected catalog-to-armory path.
dispositions.trace: ItemCatalog::wearable filters item definitions through is_wearable, which requires an equipment material and at least one placement with a nonempty surface. The exhibit producer obtains each wearable CatalogItem, retains an immutable clone of that exact definition with one retained ordinal per placement, and filters those retained selections using the same nonempty-surface condition. At least the previously required placement survives, so placements[0] used by Exhibit::item and the inspected UI is present. The fitted vector is initially constructed once per placement, and fit_exhibits maps each placement to one result.
dispositions.limits: This reasoning is limited to the inspected producer and ordinary subsequent fitting. It does not prove every direct construction or mutation of the pub(super) exhibit fields, all selected-exhibit indices, generated geometry, panics in fitting or runtime behavior. No catalog, armory, UI, generation, test or product probe ran.
